full_name: EuroQol EQ-5D (3-level) with US index (Shaw et al.)
domains: Mobility; Self-Care; Usual Activities; Pain/Discomfort; Anxiety/Depression
scoring: responses mapped to utility (0 = death, 1 = perfect health) with US index of Shaw et al. 2005
target_population: general health-state measure; here low vision rehabilitation patients
notes: Telephone administration (p3); responsiveness evaluated (effect size, correlation with AI); p2 for domains

domains: 50 goals and 460 tasks nested under goals; functional domains reading, mobility, visual information processing, visual motor function
response_scale: difficulty rating of items important/relevant to the patient (adaptive)
scoring: Rasch (Andrich rating scale model, Winsteps) ability in logits; items rated not difficult at baseline filtered out
notes: Item bank counts p2; Rasch p3; item measures anchored to values from >3400 low vision patients (p4)
